MARROW.TallyHint: The jobs you have walked away from. It does nothing at all.

DamageApplied.UndoneNote: Undone -- {name} is back where this started.
DamageApplied.UndoMissingActor: That actor no longer exists. Nothing to undo.

MARROW.AnyDamageIsAWound: Any damage taken is one Wound
MARROW.SelectATarget: Select the token this damage lands on.
MARROW.APHint: You ignore all damage less than your Armor Points. A hit that meets or beats them destroys the armor and the remainder goes into you.
MARROW.DRHint: Damage Reduction always subtracts first, and keeps working after the armor is gone.
MARROW.AAHint: Anti-Armor: ignores and destroys armor on any hit.
MARROW.KindHint: Left blank, the kind is read from the Armor Points: Soft 0–4, Mail 5–7, Plate 8–10.
MARROW.WardedHint: Removes the Disadvantage on Blight Saves. It does not remove the Save.
MARROW.DestroyedHint: Destroyed armor contributes no Armor Points, but its Damage Reduction keeps working.
MARROW.BleedingHint: Damage per round, cumulative, ignoring armor and Damage Reduction.
MARROW.RestHint: Rest: a Save on your worst Save. On a success, shed the ones digit of the roll.
MARROW.MinStressHint: Your Minimum Stress, including anything the Blight is adding.

Empty.Skills: No Skills. Remember what you do not know.

Tag.AntiArmorHint: Ignores and destroys armor on any hit.
Tag.ReloadHint: Reloading is your action for the round.
Tag.ReachHint: Strikes at one range band further than its length suggests.

Consequence.CriticalPanic: Critical Failure — make a Panic Check.
Consequence.StressOverflow: Stress is at its maximum. {n} over — reduce the most relevant Stat or Save by that amount.

Death.FaceDown: {name}'s Death Save is face down on the table. It is revealed only when somebody spends a turn checking the body.

Blight.Label: Blight
Blight.ExposureHint: Body Save at Disadvantage. On a failure, gain 1 Blight.

Note.clean: No Blight. Most people begin here and never leave.
Note.touched: The marks begin. You start noticing that you understand things nobody taught you.
Note.steeped: Minimum Stress +1. Each dawn, make a Body Save or take 1d10 damage. Strangers cross the road.
Note.consumed: Minimum Stress +1 again. [-] on all Body Saves. Rest no longer restores your Health. You are past mending.
Note.undone: You die in 1d5 days. Nothing prevents it and nothing delays it. Spend the days well.

Working.NeedsBlight: A Working needs a Blight Level of 1 or higher.
Working.FormulaHint: Use {B} for the caster's Blight Level, e.g. {B}d10
Working.LadderNote: The Working always happens. The Sanity Save decides only what it takes out of you.

Outcome.criticalSuccess: It works. It costs you nothing.
Outcome.failure: It works. Gain 1 Stress and 1 Blight.
Outcome.criticalFailure: It works, and something comes through alongside it.

Retainer.MotivationHint: Only the memorable ones need one.
Retainer.MotivationWarning: This companion has a Motivation. They always fail a Loyalty Save when the two are in conflict. Always.
Retainer.ShortedHint: Short them or stiff them and every future Loyalty Save is at [-].
Retainer.ShortedWarning: Wages shorted: every Loyalty Save is at [-].
Retainer.DangerMoneyHint: An extra month's wage, sometimes two, before they walk into that ground. Negotiate it at the fire.
Retainer.DeathPriceHint: Usually a year's wage, named before setting out. Pay it. Word travels faster than you do.

Class.ChoiceNote: This class lets you place one adjustment yourself:
Class.MissingSkill: This class grants the Skill "{name}", which is not in the Skills compendium.

Table.Missing: No roll table named "{name}" was found in the world or in MARROW's compendiums.

Dialog.InnateDisadvantage: This Check already carries a Disadvantage you cannot set aside.

Settings.AutoBleedHint: At the start of a bleeding character's turn, apply their Bleeding damage without being asked.
Settings.AutoPanicHint: Roll the Panic Check automatically whenever a Check comes up a Critical Failure.
Settings.AutoStressHint: Add the 1 Stress a failed Stat Check or Save costs, without being asked.

Creation.Title: Making Your Character
Creation.Name: Name
Creation.NoClasses: The Classes compendium is not available.
Creation.ChoiceSummary: {amount} to one Stat of your choice
Creation.BlightNote: This class begins play carrying the Blight. Every level is a permanent -1 to all Stats and all Saves, and it only goes up.
Creation.GenerateHint: Roll this character: Stats, Saves, Health, silver, Class, Skills, Loadout, Trinket and Crest.
Creation.ReplaceBody: This rolls {name} again from scratch. Their numbers, Class, Skills and everything they are carrying will be replaced.

MARROW.PatchHint: A leatherworker's kit patches torn armor back to serviceable, but patched armor has AP 1 until a proper smith sees it.
MARROW.SmithHint: A smith restores full AP for a quarter of the armor's price and a week's work.
